new_mutation_anchors.label: W01 ★★★ the retired DEFAULT is restored for an empty name — an unnamed node advertises `MeshRoute node: 0x<hash>` again (D10 undone)
W02 ★★ a TERMINATOR is reserved — the copy is clamped to cap - 1 and NUL-terminated, so a 32-byte name loses its last byte on the wire
W03 ★ the EMPTY path writes a terminator (out[0] = NUL when unnamed) — the count is still 0, but `writes nothing` is broken
W04 ★★ the CAPACITY is ignored — the whole stored name is copied whatever `cap` the caller passed
R01 ★★★ an EMPTY advertisement ERASES a retained name — the refresh guard `name && name_len` loses its count term (B447's unnamed half)
